svg.text: PROCESS FLOW — the message verification engine: eight stations in series; every rejection leaves by the exhaust with a named reason
EXHAUST — rejection reasons as named in the code (10):
unsigned, revoked, wrong_key, expired, not_permitted, binding, no_credential, credential_invalid, subject_mismatch, malformed
register #45: each of 15 registered checks rejected for its expected reason in 30/30 runs; 0 legitimate SPaT rejected of 138,895
TIMING — per-message verification cost (medians), log scale; the budget marks are the ones the latency budget declares
0.226 ms PKI verify (in-process, CA sig + CRL) [#21]
0.142 ms SSI BSM verify WARM (cached key) [#27]
0.363 ms SSI BSM verify COLD (credential verify) [#27]
15.513 ms ERC-1056 verify UNCACHED (4 RPC, local node) [#21]
0.5 ms: 100 neighbours in half the interval (P*(0.5)=100)
Bars are medians from different runs and hosts (register conditions); they are placed on one scale for orientation only. Within-run comparisons are the ones the register makes (guide 1.1.7).

DWG-003 VERIFICATION ENGINE — EIGHT-STATION PROCESS FLOW
B 2026-10-31 DWG-007 added; test paths; Layer 5 o AAR-39
1. Station order follows InfrastructureLayer.verify (cv2x-testbed/sumo/infrastructure_layer.py) and FreshnessPolicy
(cv2x-testbed/identity/freshness.py); the V2V SSI layer runs S1, S3-S6, S8.
2. Limits (depth, values, window, cache) are read from the source constants at build time; a change in code changes this sheet and fails --check until
3. S6 cold path verifies the attached credential through the canonical VC layer (2_w3c-ssi-layer/verifiable-credentials) against the trusted-issuer
list; warm path uses the cached signing address.
4. Residual, by design: a fresh message relayed within the window to a receiver that never heard it passes S4 (register #45 'not covered').
5. Timing bars: #21 host 2.10 GHz Xeon (PKI, ERC-1056 uncached, n=50); #27 mock mobility, 30 seeded runs; #44 verifier v3, 30 runs. No radio or
